latestPosts.title: Harness²: Improve the Agent Without Retraining the Model
latestPosts.author: The ByteLand Team
latestPosts.description: Google Research's Harness² refines prompts, tools and workflows around a fixed model. We explain its two loops and run the credential-free local demo.

latestPosts.title: Faster BERT Tokenization: Keep the Output Contract Intact
latestPosts.author: The ByteLand Team
latestPosts.description: Hugging Face's new tokenizer proposal removes unnecessary Unicode work. A real BERT baseline check shows why adoption tests must include source offsets.

latestPosts.title: GitHub's AI Security Upgrades: Three Controls, Three Different Jobs
latestPosts.author: The ByteLand Team
latestPosts.description: AI Scan finds possible risks, agentic autofix proposes repairs, and workflow lockfiles control what runs. Their boundaries matter as much as their capabilities.
